title: 10 · Settings panel · rackhound
strengths: A costume worn consistently: box-drawing frames, block-character switches and sliders, tmux status lines, a pixel face for titles only; underneath it is the Linear / Dash settings anatomy (label left, one-line description, control right)

Details only this product would have: 'up 41d 03:12 · load 0.42 0.38 0.31', 'fans 1820 rpm', the fan-curve preview with 'now 58' and 'target 62', an apply log that reads 'set fan.target=62°C ........ ok' and a 'retry' line

Every control has its states (switch off/on/hover/focus/applying/locked; segmented, slider, input in hover/focus/disabled/dragging/over limit/error/read-only), and the hierarchy works by brightness alone
slop_signals: Phosphor glow and scanlines on every line of text: the dark + neon family, and the dim amber hint text sits close to the 4.5:1 floor
The 56 px pixel 'settings' title with a block cursor and the '#10' numeral are the theme talking louder than the panel
fixes: Halve the glow radius on body text and keep the full glow for the bright readouts ('62°C', '85W') only
Set the page title at the panel-title size (the same as 'power & fans') and drop the cursor block

references.what: Label-left, one-line description, control-right rows grouped under headings; our rows follow this exactly
Dark settings with radio groups and switches labelled 'On'; a theme group with System / Light / Dark
Developer settings in dark where the only colour is the switch and a 'Save changes' button
Black settings with sections on the left and rows of switches on the right; shows how little a dark settings page needs

owner.said: okay, but I don't know who will use it

changed: Gave it an audience and a job: the web console an ML infrastructure team uses for GPU servers in a colocation cage; this page sets one pool's power and thermal policy to stay under the 12.5 kW the rack is contracted for
Kept the label-left rows with consequences, block sliders and switches, the fan-curve preview, the change log and the amber brand

Costume quietened: no scanlines, glow, cursor or mode line; grey text and frames; amber only for live, changed or chosen values; red only for over-contract or failed; VT323 only on the title and readouts

Real, re-added data: node draws 11.40 kW; full load 8 x (4 x W + base, fans included); 310 W is the most that fits; one alert rule above 12.0 kW; single-feed cap against a 10.5 kW feed; three racks, 31 kW
States: drag over the contract (apply disabled), applying 5 of 8, partial failure with gpu-07 at 330 W (12.03 kW, alert logged, retry and undo all)
Engine: raw.domain set to the ML-infra job, depth 10 to 4, rebuilt; brand #ffb000 checked
Fresh-eyes audit 3/5, then 4/5; the remaining notes fixed

facts: Body copy is 14 px mono, below the brief's 15-17 px web body; legible at 13:1 and recorded as the console's exception
The 56 px VT323 budget readout is off the token scale on purpose (preflight warns)
